pr_title: Fix filesystem drag&drop move&copy for directories
pr_body:
Make drag and drop for directories in the filesystem panel functional.
The current behaviour results in errors displayed and no move being performed.
Changed tested with right click > move and drag & drop for both single and multiple directories and single and multiple files

Previous:
![prev_behaviour](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/494097/233215693-acc02a16-4da1-4476-813a-2ed1e994282e.gif)
New:
![new_behaviour](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/494097/233215738-1b8a4755-4ad6-4d46-9394-471eb115b346.gif)
<!--
Please target the `master` branch in priority.
PRs can target `3.x` if the same change was done in `master`, or is not relevant there.

Relevant fixes are cherry-picked for stable branches as need
ed by maintainers.
You can mention in the description if the change is compatible with `3.x`.
-->

*Bugsquad edit:* Fixes #77689
pr_comments: The android check seems to be failing on post build tasks for the last few PRs. It might require a restart when the ci is fully functional again. I have, just in case, built the android templates locally and they are building just fine :)
Seems like copying folder (drag and drop with Ctrl held or Copy To context menu option) does not work as well. Could you try fixing it too?
Sounds like a similar fix. After work I'll give it a go

So, the change is done and now it works consistently for both copy & move.
This is, in my opinion, what a user expects when dragging or using the menu to copy/move a directory.
However, in the case of overwrite (a directory with the same name exists) it will copy the content of the directory.
This is not a "new bug", this is just the old behaviour except that drag&drop also worked the same way.
It might be worth further improving upon this change (either on this PR or another PR) so that normal copy, overwrite and keep both all work consistently
For some reason you can't copy empty directories 🤔

I will test empty directories and fix the comment.
I might actually spend some more time on it and see if I can come up with something a bit more comprehensive.
There are still some behaviour which might be surprising (as they are different from what every file manager out there does). Maybe is time for me to come up with my first proposal rather than just fixing stuff :)

While at it, I noticed one more problem. #23778, but with directories. The `new_path` ends with `/`, so if you move a directory to the same parent directory, the new path will be `old_path` + `/`, which leads to the spurious warning.

btw the bug fixed by this PR seems to be regression from #75330 🙃

> However, in the case of overwrite (a directory with the same name exists) it will copy the content of the directory.

I think this is correct behavior. File managers work like that (at least that's what I observed on Windows).

It copies the file content, but in the root of the destination directory (not in the subdirectory with the same name as the one you are trying to move). Windows and all the linux file managers I know of (not sure about apple, but I can ask someone that actually has one), would overwrite the file with the same name in the directory with the same name.
Not sure if the explanation is any clearer than before :)
I will take a look at the issues you linked

As a side note, thing that I was thinking about:

- I think it would be good to have the "move only files" and/or "move files and sub-directories", which is the current drag&drop behaviour, but as an option in the Move/Duplicate To dialog
- Likewise, it might be nice to have a "select all" right click option in the file dialog
All my godot projects are pretty small so far, but those options might actually be helpful for people with large project.
At the same time I expect most people would expect the default drag&drop to move/copy directories like any other file manager would
Superseded by #78057. Thanks for the contribution!

issue_context.title: Can't move directories in filesystem dock
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.1 dev3

### System information

Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (NVIDIA; 30.0.15.1403) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700HQ CPU @ 2.80GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

Trying to move a folder results in moving error and it's not moved.
Regression from #75330

A fix already exists, but I'm opening an issue so it's not lost (the PR isn't ready and not very active).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add 2 folders in filesystem
2. Move one folder into another one

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A
comments:
This is a serious issue, it needs to be fixed ASAP.
Not being able to move folders in the filesystem dock (that is, without breaking resource references) is totally debilitating.
As a workaround you can move all of the folder's files. It has the same effect.

> As a workaround you can move all of the folder's files. It has the same effect.

This is nearly impossible with lots of nesting, though.
